title: Steering Vision-Language Models for Visual-Contextual Privacy in Location Disclosure
abstract: arXiv:2610.27323v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can infer sensitive information such as geolocation from subtle visual cues, creating privacy risks when responses disclose more detail than the visual context warrants. We study visual-contextual privacy in geolocation disclosure, where a VLM should reveal location information only at the granularity appropriate to the visual context depicted in the image. We first show that this contextually appropriate granularity is recoverable from pre-generation hidden states, even when generated responses are misaligned, with disclosure levels exhibiting an ordered structure along a common hidden-state direction. Motivated by this, we propose an inference-time route-and-steer framework: an ordinal granularity router maps visual-contextual privacy representations to a disclosure route, and a disclosure-level-conditioned steering module applies route-specific hidden-state interventions during decoding. Across four VLM

translated_title: 面向位置披露中视觉语境隐私的视觉语言模型引导方法
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）能够从细微的视觉线索中推断出地理位置等敏感信息，当其回复所披露的细节超出视觉语境所应有的范围时，就会产生隐私风险。我们研究了地理位置披露中的视觉语境隐私问题，即视觉语言模型应仅在与其图像所描绘的视觉语境相适应的粒度上披露位置信息。我们首先证明，即使在生成的回复出现失调的情况下，这种与语境相适应的粒度仍可从生成前的隐藏状态中恢复出来，且披露程度沿着一个共同的隐藏状态方向呈现出有序结构。受此启发，我们提出了一种推理时的“路由-引导”框架：一个序数粒度路由器将视觉语境隐私表征映射到披露路径，同时一个以披露层级为条件的引导模块在解码过程中施加针对特定路径的隐藏状态干预。在四个视觉语言模型上（实验结果……）
tldr: 提出一种推理时的“路由-引导”框架，通过基于隐藏状态的干预使视觉语言模型在地理位置披露时遵循与图像视觉语境相适应的隐私粒度。
en_tdlr: Proposes an inference-time route-and-steer framework that uses hidden-state interventions to make vision-language models disclose location information only at privacy granularities appropriate to the visual context of the image.
